entries.en: The letter from Academgorodok reached her after she had packed the photographs away.
entries.zh: 从科学城寄来的信送到她手中时，她已经把照片收起来了。

entries.en: The cabinetmaker rejected the acajou panel because a crack ran through its centre.
entries.zh: 细木工没有采用那块桃花心木板，因为中间贯穿着一道裂缝。

entries.en: She wanted a second opinion about her acalcemia before cancelling the trip.
entries.zh: 在取消旅行之前，她想就自己的缺钙血症再听一位医生的意见。

entries.en: The veterinarian postponed the discussion of acalcicosis until the calf's owner arrived.
entries.zh: 兽医将缺钙症的讨论推迟到小牛主人到场后。

entries.en: Her acalculia made the cash payment confusing, so she asked the cashier to check the change.
entries.zh: 计算力缺失使她在现金付款时感到困惑，于是她请收银员核对找零。

entries.en: The artist drew the acalycinous flower larger so its structure could be seen from the back of the room.
entries.zh: 画家把那朵无花萼的花画大了，好让房间后面的人也能看清它的结构。

entries.en: Her review of the Acalypteratae collection uncovered several specimens that had never been photographed.
entries.zh: 她检查无翅瓣类收藏时，发现了几份从未拍过照的标本。

entries.en: The students disagreed about whether the damaged specimen belonged in Acalyptratae.
entries.zh: 学生们对那份受损标本是否应归入无翅瓣类意见不一。

entries.en: She rescued her sketch of Acamar before the spilled coffee reached it.
entries.zh: 洒出的咖啡还没流到那幅天园六素描上，她就把它抢救了出来。

entries.meaningZh: 自动通信与信息处理系统〔ACAMPS系统名〕
entries.en: Missing archival records interrupted her study of the Automated Communications and Message Processing System (ACAMPS).
entries.zh: 档案记录缺失，打断了她对ACAMPS自动通信与信息处理系统的研究。

entries.en: His acampsia prevented him from bending the joint far enough for the pose.
entries.zh: 由于屈挠不能，他无法把关节弯曲到摆出那个姿势所需的程度。

entries.en: Their comparison of Acanthamoeba images had to wait while the microscope camera was being repaired.
entries.zh: 显微镜相机正在维修，他们只得暂缓比较棘阿米巴属的图像。

entries.en: She borrowed drawings of Acantharia to replace the blurred photographs in the exhibition.
entries.zh: 她借来了棘骨虫亚纲的图画，替换展览中那些模糊的照片。

entries.en: The acanthesthesia in his fingertips distracted him throughout the interview.
entries.zh: 整个面谈过程中，指尖的针刺感使他分了心。

entries.en: The missing drawings left their comparison of Acanthobdellidea with other leech groups incomplete.
entries.zh: 图画缺失，使他们对棘蛭目与其他蛭类类群的比较未能完成。

entries.en: The farmer requested the earlier records before discussing the suspected acanthocephaliasis with the vet.
entries.zh: 农场主要求先提供早先的记录，再与兽医讨论疑似棘头虫病的情况。

entries.en: The damaged slide left her unsure whether the specimen belonged to Acanthocheilonema.
entries.zh: 玻片损坏了，她无法确定那份标本是否属于棘唇属。

entries.en: A missing volume delayed her study of Acanthocheilonematidae.
entries.zh: 缺了一卷资料，她对棘唇科的研究因而耽搁了。

entries.en: She took leave while the specialists reviewed her suspected acanthocheilonemiasis.
entries.zh: 专科医生复核她疑似棘唇虫病的情况期间，她休了假。

entries.en: The museum's new drawings made the older reconstruction of Acanthodii harder to defend.
entries.zh: 博物馆的新图画让先前对棘鱼纲的复原更难站得住脚。

entries.en: The appointment concerning his acanthokeratodermia was moved to a room with better lighting.
entries.zh: 关于他角质肥厚问题的面诊改到了照明更好的房间。

entries.en: The acantholytic changes were difficult to distinguish in the damaged photograph.
entries.zh: 那张受损的照片中，皮肤棘层松解的变化难以辨认。

entries.en: The artist corrected the drawing of the acanthopelvis after noticing that one projection was missing.
entries.zh: 插画师发现漏画了一个突起后，修改了那幅棘状骨盆图。

entries.en: The museum's acanthulus was too delicate to display beside the larger instruments.
entries.zh: 博物馆的那件拔刺器太纤弱，不适合陈列在那些较大的器械旁边。

entries.meaningZh: 高级阵列处理计算机〔计算机缩写〕
entries.en: Replacing the ACAP would have cost more than repairing the rest of the old installation.
entries.zh: 更换那台高级阵列处理计算机的费用，会超过修复那套旧装置其余部分的费用。

entries.en: In the old case history, acaptosis prevents the traveller from sharing a meal.
entries.zh: 在那份旧病历中，咽下不能使旅行者无法与他人一起进餐。

entries.en: The order for acarbose was cancelled when the research project lost its funding.
entries.zh: 研究项目失去经费后，那笔阿卡波糖订单被取消了。

entries.en: The acardiac fetus was shown from two angles in the anatomical atlas.
entries.zh: 那本解剖图谱从两个角度展示了无心畸胎。

entries.en: The curator chose a model of an acardiacus rather than a photograph for the display.
entries.zh: 策展人选择用无心畸胎模型而不是照片来陈列。

entries.meaningZh: 心内血液缺乏〔医学用语〕
entries.en: The physician suspected acardiohemia but could not explain the conflicting observations.
entries.zh: 那位医生怀疑存在心内血液缺乏，却无法解释相互矛盾的观察结果。

entries.meaningZh: 心神经刺激缺乏〔医学用语〕
entries.en: His account of acardionervia persuaded neither of the two consulting physicians.
entries.zh: 他对心神经刺激缺乏的解释没有说服参与会诊的两位医生中的任何一位。

entries.en: The missing photographs prevented the illustrator from completing the drawing of the acardius.
entries.zh: 照片缺失，插画师未能完成那幅无心畸胎图。

entries.en: The trial's claim of an acaricidal effect was questioned because the control group was missing.
entries.zh: 由于缺少对照组，人们质疑那项试验关于杀螨作用的说法。

entries.en: The acaridan in the drawing was enlarged enough for the children to see its outline.
entries.zh: 图中的螨被放大到了孩子们能看清轮廓的程度。

entries.en: They postponed the livestock sale while the veterinarian investigated the suspected acarinosis.
entries.zh: 兽医调查疑似螨病期间，他们推迟了牲畜交易。

entries.meaningZh: 阿卡纳尼亚〔古希腊地区名〕
entries.en: His comparison of maps of ancient Acarnania depended on a volume that the library had misplaced.
entries.zh: 他要比较古代阿卡纳尼亚的地图，却需要用到一本被图书馆放错了地方的书。

entries.meaningZh: 阿卡纳尼亚的〔古希腊地区〕
entries.en: Her comparison of Acarnanian pottery was interrupted when the museum closed for repairs.
entries.zh: 博物馆因维修闭馆，打断了她对阿卡纳尼亚陶器的比较。

entries.en: He asked whether his suspected acarodermatitis could be assessed before he left for the island.
entries.zh: 他问能否在自己动身去岛上之前，对疑似螨性皮炎的情况作出评估。

entries.en: Her interest in acarology began with the tiny creatures she found beneath fallen leaves.
entries.zh: 她对蜱螨学的兴趣，始于自己在落叶下面发现的那些微小生物。

entries.en: The gardener compared the trees affected by acarpia with those that had borne fruit.
entries.zh: 园丁将不结果实的树与那些已经结果的树作了比较。

entries.en: The specimens assigned to Acartomyia needed new photographs before the exhibition could open.
entries.zh: 那些被归入库蚊亚科Acartomyia属的标本需要重新拍照，展览才能开幕。

entries.en: Acat found a dry place for the drawings beneath the kitchen table.
entries.zh: 阿贾特在厨房桌子下面给那些图画找了个干燥的存放处。

entries.en: The family disagreed about who should attend the meeting concerning their child's acatalasemia.
entries.zh: 家人对该由谁参加那场有关孩子缺过氧化氢酶血症的会面意见不一。

entries.en: Her concerns about acatalasia remained unanswered when the appointment ended.
entries.zh: 面诊结束时，她对过氧化氢酶缺乏症的担忧仍未得到解答。

entries.en: The conflicting accounts left her in a state of acatalepsy, unable to reach a firm conclusion.
entries.zh: 那些相互矛盾的陈述使她陷入领会不能的状态，无法得出确定的结论。

entries.en: Acataposis made the long banquet an ordeal for him.
entries.zh: 咽下困难使那场漫长的宴会成了他的一场煎熬。

entries.en: Her acathisia made it difficult to remain seated throughout the play.
entries.zh: 静坐不能使她难以在整场戏期间一直坐着。

entries.en: The acauline fungus was almost hidden behind the moss in her drawing.
entries.zh: 她的画中，那株无茎真菌几乎被苔藓挡住了。

entries.en: The earlier photographs were missing from the file on his suspected acaulinosis.
entries.zh: 关于他疑似无茎真菌病的档案中，早先的照片不见了。

entries.en: Their comparison of Acaulium cultures was interrupted by a power failure.
entries.zh: 停电打断了他们对无茎真菌属培养物的比较。

entries.en: She placed an acaulous plant beside the taller specimens to vary the display.
entries.zh: 她在那些较高的标本旁摆了一株无茎植物，使陈列有所变化。

entries.en: Accad brought a folding chair because the hall had no seats left.
entries.zh: 阿卡德带来了一把折叠椅，因为大厅里已经没有空座位了。

entries.en: Her translation of the Accadian fragment differed from the version in the exhibition catalogue.
entries.zh: 她对那段阿卡得语残文的翻译，与展览图录中的版本不同。

entries.meaningZh: 社区癌症中心协会〔旧机构名缩写ACCC〕
entries.en: The archive lent her an old report from the Association of Community Cancer Centers (ACCC).
entries.zh: 档案馆借给她一份社区癌症中心协会的旧报告。

entries.en: The damaged drawing made the course of the accelerans difficult to follow.
entries.zh: 图画损坏了，加速神经的走向难以辨认。

entries.en: The historian questioned whether the old experiments had established the identity of acceleransstoff.
entries.zh: 那位历史学者质疑，那些早期实验是否已经确定了加速物质的身份。

entries.en: The replacement accelerator-activator arrived after the trial had already been cancelled.
entries.zh: 替换用的促进剂-活性剂送到时，试验已经取消了。

entries.meaningZh: 促凝血球蛋白〔活化的第V因子〕
entries.en: The team could not compare accelerin activity because the earlier measurements had been lost.
entries.zh: 早先的测量记录丢失了，小组无法比较促凝血球蛋白的活性。

entries.en: They excluded the discoloured accelerine from the comparison rather than assume it was unchanged.
entries.zh: 他们没有假定那份变色的对亚硝基-N,N-二甲基苯胺仍保持原样，而是将其排除在比较之外。

entries.en: The Accelerotor could not be moved into the new room until the doorway was widened.
entries.zh: 门口加宽以后，那台埃克西来罗试验仪才能搬进新房间。

entries.en: The student traced the accessorius on the model before attempting the drawing.
entries.zh: 学生先在模型上沿着副神经的走向看了一遍，再尝试作图。

entries.en: Her drawings of Accladium were returned because the details could not be seen at that scale.
entries.zh: 她画的皮疡霉菌属图画被退回了，因为按那个比例看不清细节。

entries.en: His acclimatation took longer than expected, so he postponed the more demanding walks.
entries.zh: 他的气候适应比预想中花的时间更长，因此他推迟了那些较费力的徒步活动。

entries.en: The workshop kept the unused Accoloy for the next exhibition rather than discard it.
entries.zh: 车间保留了未用过的镍铬铁耐热合金，准备留给下一次展览，而没有丢弃。

entries.en: The older drawings did not show the extent of accrementition visible in the later photographs.
entries.zh: 较早的图画没有显示出后来照片中可见的增生程度。

entries.en: A tear in the accumulator-separator delayed the restoration of the old battery.
entries.zh: 蓄电池隔板上的一处破口耽搁了那只旧电池的修复。

entries.en: The university declined the donation of aceanthrene because its research collection was being closed.
entries.zh: 大学因为正在关闭其研究藏品库，没有接受那批醋蒽捐赠。

entries.en: The laboratory's request for acecainide was omitted from the revised budget.
entries.zh: 实验室申请购买乙酰卡尼的款项没有列入修订后的预算。

entries.en: The analyst refused to compare the acecarbromal with an unidentified powder.
entries.zh: 分析员不肯把那份醋卡溴脲与一种身份不明的粉末作比较。

entries.en: The damaged container of acecoline was excluded from the shipment.
entries.zh: 那只装有氯化乙酰胆硷的破损容器被排除在发货批次之外。

entries.en: She could not complete the comparison without the acedapsone that the other laboratory had promised.
entries.zh: 没有另一间实验室答应提供的二乙酰氨苯砜，她就无法完成比较。

entries.en: The missing invoice left the purchase of acediasulfone unresolved at the end of the meeting.
entries.zh: 发票缺失，会议结束时，购买醋地砜一事仍未解决。

entries.en: The museum borrowed an empty Acedicon package for its display of historical medicine containers.
entries.zh: 博物馆借来一个阿西迪康空包装，用于陈列历史药品容器的展览。

entries.en: The research team returned the unopened aceglatone when the project was cancelled.
entries.zh: 项目取消后，研究小组退回了尚未开封的醋葡醛内酯。

entries.en: A dispute over the cost of aceglutamide delayed the laboratory's order.
entries.zh: 对醋谷胺费用的争议耽搁了实验室的订单。

entries.en: She translated the invitation into Acehnese before asking her paternal grandmother to check it.
entries.zh: 她把邀请函译成亚齐语，然后请祖母帮忙检查。

entries.en: A student shaded Aceldama on a map she drew to accompany her discussion of the biblical narrative.
entries.zh: 一名学生为自己对《圣经》叙事的讨论画了地图，并在图上给血田涂了阴影。

entries.meaningZh: 阿西尔〔醋酯纤维商品名Acele〕
entries.en: The archivist found an Acele acetate swatch sewn inside the back cover of the old catalogue.
entries.zh: 档案管理员发现，那本旧图录的封底内侧缝着一块阿西尔醋酯纤维样布。

entries.en: The illustrator left the drawing of acelia unfinished rather than invent the missing details.
entries.zh: 插画师没有凭空补上缺失的细节，而是让那幅无腹畸形图保持未完成的状态。

entries.en: The damaged specimen made it difficult to decide whether the animal was acelomate.
entries.zh: 标本损坏了，难以判断那只动物是否无体腔。

entries.en: The discussion of acelosis continued after the anatomy seminar had officially ended.
entries.zh: 解剖学研讨会正式结束后，关于无体腔畸形的讨论仍在继续。

entries.en: The acelous surface was difficult to show clearly in a photograph taken from above.
entries.zh: 从上方拍摄的照片难以清楚展现那个没有凹陷的表面。

entries.en: The supplier refunded the payment for acemetacin after the university withdrew its order.
entries.zh: 大学撤回订单后，供应商退还了购买阿西美辛的款项。

entries.en: The comparison of acenaphthene samples was postponed because one package had gone missing.
entries.zh: 由于一个包裹不见了，苊样品的比较被推迟了。

entries.en: Her analysis of acenaphthenone was interrupted when the recording equipment failed.
entries.zh: 记录设备出了故障，打断了她对苊酮的分析。

entries.en: The laboratory could not account for the acenaphthylene listed in the previous year's inventory.
entries.zh: 实验室无法说明上一年清单中所列苊烯的下落。

entries.en: The students compared drawings of several acenes before choosing one for their model.
entries.zh: 学生们比较了几种并苯的图画，然后选了一种来做模型。

entries.meaningZh: 存在感觉缺失〔医学用语〕
entries.en: He found it difficult to describe his acenesthesia during the brief appointment.
entries.zh: 在那次简短的面诊中，他发现很难描述自己存在感觉缺失的情况。

entries.en: The study involving acenocoumarin was suspended while its funding was reconsidered.
entries.zh: 在重新考虑经费期间，那项涉及醋硝香豆素的研究暂停了。

entries.en: The missing acenocoumarol prevented the laboratory from completing its planned comparison.
entries.zh: 醋硝香豆素缺失，使实验室未能完成原定的比较。

entries.en: Her study of aceology drew her toward medical history rather than clinical practice.
entries.zh: 对药疗学的研究使她转向了医学史，而不是临床实践。

entries.en: Her comparison of the two aceperinaphthane models was interrupted when one broke.
entries.zh: 她比较那两个醋代萘烷模型时，其中一个坏了，比较因此中断。

entries.en: The team removed aceperone from the proposed study because the necessary records were unavailable.
entries.zh: 由于无法取得必要的记录，小组把醋哌隆排除在拟议研究之外。

entries.meaningZh: 头部血液缺乏〔医学用语〕
entries.en: The specialist doubted the earlier account of acephalemia because the observations contradicted one another.
entries.zh: 专科医生怀疑先前有关头部血液缺乏的记述，因为那些观察结果相互矛盾。

entries.en: The exhibition's photographs of Acephalina were replaced with drawings that showed the details more clearly.
entries.zh: 展览中的无头亚目照片被换成了能更清楚地显示细节的图画。

entries.en: The apparent case of acephalobrachia could not be assessed from the blurred photograph alone.
entries.zh: 仅凭那张模糊的照片，无法评估那个疑似无头无臂畸形的病例。

entries.en: The wax model of an acephalobrachius was damaged while the exhibition was being moved.
entries.zh: 搬迁展览时，一件无头无臂畸胎蜡模损坏了。

entries.en: The disputed account of acephalocardia was reconsidered when the original drawings became available.
entries.zh: 取得原始图画后，人们重新审视了那份存在争议的无头无心畸形记述。

entries.en: The illustrator requested another view of the acephalocardius before completing the atlas plate.
entries.zh: 插画师要求在完成图谱中的图版之前，再提供那个无头无心畸胎的另一个视图。

entries.en: The lecture on acephalochiria ended with questions about the reliability of the surviving illustrations.
entries.zh: 关于无头无手畸形的讲座，以对留存插图可靠性的提问结束。

entries.en: An incomplete drawing of the acephalochirus occupied the centre of the damaged page.
entries.zh: 那张破损页面的中央是一幅尚未完成的无头无手畸胎图。

entries.en: The acephalocyst was difficult to distinguish from the surrounding material in the faded photograph.
entries.zh: 在那张褪色的照片中，无头囊难以与周围物质区分开来。

entries.en: The museum declined to display the acephalogaster without an explanation of the specimen's provenance.
entries.zh: 由于没有说明那份标本的来源，博物馆不愿展出那个无头胸上腹畸胎。

entries.en: The student's comparison of two cases of acephalopodia omitted several differences visible in the drawings.
entries.zh: 学生比较两个无头无足畸形病例时，漏掉了图中可见的几处差别。

entries.en: A second drawing of the acephalopodius contradicted the reconstruction shown in the catalogue.
entries.zh: 那个无头无足畸胎的另一幅图，与图录中的复原图相矛盾。

entries.en: The curator could not locate the photograph needed to identify the acephalorrhachus in the collection.
entries.zh: 策展人找不到鉴定藏品中那个无头无脊柱畸胎所需的照片。

entries.en: Her research on acephalothoracia was delayed when access to the historical collection was suspended.
entries.zh: 历史藏品暂停开放，耽搁了她对无头无胸畸形的研究。

entries.en: The anatomical model of an acephalothorus remained in storage while its damaged base was repaired.
entries.zh: 维修损坏的底座期间，那件无头无胸畸胎解剖模型一直存放在库房里。

entries.en: The old drawing did not provide enough detail to establish whether the specimen was an acephalus.
entries.zh: 那幅旧图没有提供足够的细节，无法确定标本是否为无头畸胎。

entries.en: The investigation could not establish where the missing acephate had been taken.
entries.zh: 调查无法确定那批不见了的高灭磷被运到了哪里。

entries.en: She removed acepromazine from the purchase request after the research team changed its plans.
entries.zh: 研究小组改变计划后，她将乙酰丙嗪从采购申请中删去了。

entries.en: His acerbophobia made him anxious even before the unfamiliar food was brought to the table.
entries.zh: 陌生的食物还没端上桌，酸味恐怖就已经使他感到焦虑。

entries.en: The proposed comparison omitted acerdol because the laboratory could not obtain a documented sample.
entries.zh: 由于实验室无法取得有文件记录的高锰酸钙样品，拟议的比较没有包括它。

entries.en: The acerebral preparation was excluded from the comparison because its records were incomplete.
entries.zh: 那份去大脑标本因记录不完整，被排除在比较之外。

entries.en: The old chemist discarded the aceric extract after its provenance became doubtful.
entries.zh: 那位老化学家对槭树提取物的来源产生疑问后，丢弃了它。

entries.en: The researchers disagreed about whether the remaining acerin was sufficient for a meaningful comparison.
entries.zh: 研究人员对剩余槭素是否足以进行有意义的比较意见不一。

entries.en: The expense of obtaining aceritol forced her to reduce the number of planned comparisons.
entries.zh: 取得槭糖醇的费用迫使她减少了原定比较的次数。

entries.en: The acervuli were clearer in the enlarged image than in the original photograph.
entries.zh: 放大的图像比原始照片更清楚地显示了脑沙。

entries.en: The acervuline deposits were difficult to represent in a drawing without overlapping outlines.
entries.zh: 要把那些堆集的沉积物画出来而又不使轮廓重叠，并不容易。

entries.en: The patient asked for another opinion before accepting the suspected acervuloma as a definite diagnosis.
entries.zh: 在接受疑似沙瘤为明确诊断之前，那名患者要求再听一位医生的意见。

entries.en: The gradual acescence of the cider changed her opinion of its flavour.
entries.zh: 苹果酒逐渐变酸，使她改变了对其风味的看法。

entries.en: The acescency of the sauce pleased her more than its strong aroma did.
entries.zh: 比起那种浓烈的香气，她更喜欢酱汁的微酸味。

entries.en: He preferred the acescent dressing to the sweeter version served the previous evening.
entries.zh: 比起前一天晚上供应的较甜版本，他更喜欢那种微酸的调味汁。

entries.en: The committee questioned the evidence for the claimed acesodynous effect.
entries.zh: 委员会质疑支持所声称止痛作用的证据。

entries.en: The study's comparison of acesulfame with other substances was postponed when the equipment failed.
entries.zh: 设备发生故障，那项研究对乙酰舒泛与其他物质的比较被推迟了。

entries.en: The tasting panel was not told which samples contained acesulfame-K.
entries.zh: 试吃小组没有被告知哪些样品含有乙酰舒泛钾。

entries.en: The pharmacist compared the aceta preserved in the collection with those described in the old manual.
entries.zh: 药剂师把藏品中保存的醋剂，与那本旧手册中描述的醋剂作了比较。

entries.en: The students redrew specimens of Acetabularia after comparing their sketches with the microscope photographs.
entries.zh: 学生们把自己的草图与显微照片作了比较后，重新绘制了伞藻属标本的图画。

entries.en: She postponed the family visit because her appointment to discuss acetabulectomy had been brought forward.
entries.zh: 由于讨论髋臼切除术的面诊提前了，她推迟了探亲。

entries.en: He asked for time to consider the proposed acetabuloplasty before signing the consent form.
entries.zh: 在签署同意书之前，他要求留些时间考虑所提出的髋臼成形术。

entries.en: The proposed comparison of acetacetates had to be revised because two samples lacked reliable records.
entries.zh: 由于两份样品没有可靠记录，拟议的乙酰乙酸酯比较不得不作出调整。

entries.en: Her explanation of the failed acetalation did not account for the missing control experiment.
entries.zh: 她对那次缩醛化失败的解释，没有交代缺失的对照实验。

entries.en: The structural drawing of acetaldazine was clearer than the student's unfinished model.
entries.zh: 乙醛连氮的结构图比那个学生尚未完成的模型更清楚。

entries.en: The apparent increase in acetaldehydase activity could not be confirmed from the surviving records.
entries.zh: 乙醛酶活性似乎有所增加，但留存的记录无法证实这一点。

entries.en: The team questioned whether acetalization had been completed before the photographs were taken.
entries.zh: 小组质疑，在拍照之前缩醛化作用是否已经完成。

entries.en: The reference sample contained acetamidoeugenol, but its origin had not been recorded.
entries.zh: 那份参照样品含有醋胺丁香酚，但没有记录其来源。

entries.en: The disagreement concerned the identity of the acetamino-toluene rather than the accuracy of the measurements.
entries.zh: 争议涉及的是乙酰氨基甲苯的身份，而不是测量是否准确。

entries.en: The old acetaminosalol sample was omitted from the study because its history could not be traced.
entries.zh: 那份旧的醋氨沙洛样品因无法追溯来历，没有被纳入研究。

entries.en: She asked for the original records before comparing the two acetannin samples.
entries.zh: 在比较那两份乙酰鞣酸样品之前，她要求先提供原始记录。

entries.en: The research collection's acetarson was transferred to another institution when the department closed.
entries.zh: 系里关闭时，研究藏品中的乙酰胂胺被移交给了另一家机构。

entries.en: An incomplete invoice made it difficult to establish how the acetarsone had entered the collection.
entries.zh: 发票不完整，难以确定那份乙酰胂胺是如何进入藏品库的。

entries.en: An old bottle of sodae acetas stood apart from the ointments in the display.
entries.zh: 陈列中，一瓶旧乙酸钠与那些软膏分开摆放。

entries.en: The acetated material was compared with an untreated piece from the same batch.
entries.zh: 用醋酸处理过的材料，与同批一块未经处理的材料作了比较。

entries.en: The clinic corrected the charge for acetazolamide after she questioned the bill.
entries.zh: 她对账单提出疑问后，诊所更正了乙酰唑胺的收费。

entries.en: The analysis of acetbromamide was repeated because the first set of records was incomplete.
entries.zh: 由于第一组记录不完整，对N-溴代乙酰胺的分析重新进行了一次。

entries.en: They could not distinguish the acetbromanilide sample from the reference material using the surviving records.
entries.zh: 凭留存的记录，他们无法将那份乙酰溴苯胺样品与参照材料区分开来。

entries.en: The slides stained with acetcarmine were photographed again because the first images were out of focus.
entries.zh: 用乙酰胭脂红染色的玻片重新拍了照，因为第一批图像没有对好焦。

entries.en: An unexplained difference between the aceteugenol samples led her to question their provenance.
entries.zh: 乙酰丁香酚样品之间一处无法解释的差异，使她对其来源产生了疑问。

entries.en: The comparison of acetiamine batches remained unfinished when the laboratory moved to another building.
entries.zh: 实验室搬到另一幢楼时，对不同批次乙酰硫胺的比较仍未完成。

entries.en: The analysis could not establish whether the liquid contained acetidin.
entries.zh: 分析无法确定那种液体是否含有乙酸乙酯。

entries.en: The unexpected acetification spoiled the wine he had hoped to serve at the celebration.
entries.zh: 意外发生的成醋作用，使他原本打算在庆祝会上供应的葡萄酒坏了。

entries.en: The old acetifier was too large to fit through the museum's narrow entrance.
entries.zh: 那台旧醋化器太大，无法通过博物馆狭窄的入口。

entries.en: The acetimetric results were set aside until the disputed readings could be checked.
entries.zh: 在能够核查那些有争议的读数之前，醋酸定量结果被暂时搁置了。

entries.en: The proposed study excluded acetimidochloride because no adequately documented sample was available.
entries.zh: 由于没有记录足够完备的1-氯乙亚胺样品，拟议研究没有纳入这种物质。

entries.en: The student's molecular model was missing an acetimidoyl group shown in the structural drawing.
entries.zh: 学生的分子模型漏掉了结构图中所示的一个亚氨代乙酰基。

entries.en: The unexplained peak made her doubt the identity of the acetnaphthalide sample.
entries.zh: 那个无法解释的峰，使她怀疑乙酰萘胺样品的身份。

entries.meaningZh: 乙酰乙酰辅酶A〔用于完整复合名〕
entries.en: A second structural drawing of acetoacetyl coenzyme A revealed an error in the student's model.
entries.zh: 乙酰乙酰辅酶A的另一幅结构图，显示出那个学生的模型有一处错误。

entries.en: The researchers could not reconcile the two analyses of acetoamidophenol without the original data.
entries.zh: 没有原始数据，研究人员无法解释对乙酰氨基苯酚的两次分析为何不一致。

entries.en: The new photographs of Acetobacter were rejected because the scale was inconsistent.
entries.zh: 那批新的醋酸杆菌属照片因比例不一致而没有被采用。

entries.en: Her comparison of Acetobacteriaceae with related groups was delayed by the missing illustrations.
entries.zh: 插图缺失，耽搁了她对醋酸杆菌科与相关类群的比较。

entries.en: The team could not compare the acetobromglucose samples until the disputed records had been checked.
entries.zh: 有争议的记录核查完毕后，小组才能比较那些乙酰溴葡糖样品。

entries.en: The student revised her model of acetobromoglucose after comparing it with a second structural drawing.
entries.zh: 学生把自己的乙酰溴葡糖模型与另一幅结构图比较后，修改了模型。

entries.en: The investigation into the missing acetocaustin stalled when the delivery records could not be found.
entries.zh: 由于找不到送货记录，对那批失踪三氯乙酸的调查陷入了停顿。

entries.en: Her review of the acetochloroamide experiment uncovered a gap in the original measurements.
entries.zh: 她复核乙酰氯胺实验时，发现原始测量记录存在缺漏。

entries.en: The apparent difference between the acetocinnamone samples disappeared after a copying error was corrected.
entries.zh: 一处抄录错误纠正后，亚苄基丙酮样品之间原本显现的差异消失了。

entries.en: The chemist rejected the proposed identification of acetocyclohexane because the evidence was incomplete.
entries.zh: 由于证据不完整，化学家没有接受所提出的环己乙酮鉴定结论。

entries.en: The old acetodibromoamide sample could not be included because its provenance was uncertain.
entries.zh: 那份旧的N,N-二溴乙酰胺样品因来源不明，无法被纳入。

entries.en: The researcher could not identify the acetogen from the blurred microscope image alone.
entries.zh: 仅凭那张模糊的显微图像，研究人员无法鉴定那种产乙酸菌。

entries.en: Her comparison of acetoglycocoll samples depended on measurements that had not yet been checked.
entries.zh: 她对乙酰甘氨酸样品的比较，依赖于尚未核查的测量结果。

entries.en: They questioned the proposed identification of acetoguaiacone rather than assume the old analysis was correct.
entries.zh: 他们没有假定旧分析是正确的，而是质疑所提出的乙酰愈创木酮鉴定结论。

entries.en: She requested a receipt that listed the charge for acetohexamide separately.
entries.zh: 她要求收据单独列出乙酰苯磺酰环己脲的费用。

entries.en: The apparent difference in acetokinase activity disappeared when the team corrected a transcription error.
entries.zh: 小组纠正一处抄录错误后，乙酸激酶活性上原本显现的差异消失了。

entries.en: The proposed comparison of acetolase activity was abandoned because the earlier results could not be verified.
entries.zh: 由于无法验证早先的结果，拟议的醋酸生成酶活性比较被放弃了。

entries.en: The museum's old acetomel jar was empty, but its glass stopper was still intact.
entries.zh: 博物馆那只旧醋蜜剂罐已经空了，但玻璃塞仍完好无损。

entries.en: The chemist revised the model of acetomenaphthone after noticing an error in the structural drawing.
entries.zh: 化学家发现结构图有一处错误后，修改了2-甲基-1,4-萘二酚二乙酸酯的模型。

entries.en: The broken scale made the old acetometer unsuitable for the demonstration.
entries.zh: 刻度损坏了，那只旧醋酸计不适合用于演示。

entries.en: The disputed specimen was excluded from the display of Acetomonas until its identity could be checked.
entries.zh: 那份存在争议的标本在身份得到核查之前，被排除在醋单胞菌属的陈列之外。
